verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a payment flow (PayPal button checkout, token auth, sandbox testing), OpenAPI-based client code generation, and Braintree guides including 'Create a transaction' and an end-to-end example integration. That makes a docs-driven integration plausible, but nothing in the pack shows copy-paste payment code in multiple languages or the under-a-day timeline. Missing for 10: copy-paste checkout snippets in multiple languages, evidence of time-to-first-payment, independent or hands-on corroboration that developers integrate quickly from docs alone.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language
